Please include the product/domain, target buyer and problem, MVP workflows, whether this is TokenKitchen or a different product, pricing and billing model, launch countries/currency and tax needs, integrations, data/privacy/compliance requirements, and support/reliability expectations.
questions.answer: TokenKitchen is a billing and operations platform for small Indian food businesses, from cloud kitchens and bakeries to tea shops and quick-service counters. Staff issue token-numbered GST bills in seconds, accept payments in cash, UPI or card, and manage a live kitchen queue. Every sale automatically deducts ingredients using recipes, so owners see stock, wastage and food cost clearly. Built-in Khata tracks credit customers and supplier dues, while daily reports show sales, GST and estimated profit. Swiggy and Zomato orders will soon join the same live queue. Affordable quarterly, half-yearly and annual plans, each beginning with a 14-day free trial.
